caseName: Pons v. Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad
caseNameFull: Mrs. Carmelite Pons, Wife of George A. Louque, in Error v. Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Louisiana.
attorneys: Mr. Henry L. Lazarus and Mr. Edgar H. Farrar for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Blewett.Lee, Mr. Charles N. Burch, Mr. Hunter C. Leake, Mr. Gustave Lemle and Mr. H. D. Minor for the defendants in error.

opinions.text: Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Louisiana Navigation Co. v. Oyster Commission of La., 226 U. S. 99; United States v. Beatty, decided this term, ante, p. 463.
